top_news.title: Anthropic: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
top_news.dek: Anthropic has implemented new methods to mitigate distillation attacks, reducing unauthorized data harvesting by 90 to 99 percent.
top_news.brief: Distillation attacks involve using fraudulent accounts to extract and replicate frontier model capabilities. Anthropic's new defensive measures target these industrial-scale extraction campaigns, significantly limiting the effectiveness of unauthorized model cloning.

top_news.title: ReplaySSM: Rethinking State Storage for Faster Hybrid-Model Decoding
top_news.dek: NVIDIA's ReplaySSM optimizes state storage for hybrid models, improving decoding performance by addressing the limitations of traditional KV caches.
top_news.brief: Hybrid models combining SSM layers with attention mechanisms face unique state management challenges. ReplaySSM provides a strategy to handle state storage more efficiently, enhancing inference speed for architectures like Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing hybrid model state storage architecture

top_news.title: Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions
top_news.dek: Microsoft researchers introduced 'Fork-and-Flush,' a method that clears chat history to help AI agents escape 'idea basins' and improve performance.
top_news.brief: Autonomous agents often get stuck in local solution regions due to accumulated context. By clearing history while maintaining the workspace, the Fork-and-Flush approach allows agents to explore new strategies, yielding up to 66 percent better results.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual diagram of the Fork-and-Flush agent workflow

top_news.title: Endpoint Candidates: evaluate and promote inference endpoints
top_news.dek: Modal launched Endpoint Candidates to help developers stage, evaluate, and promote inference endpoints within production workflows.
top_news.brief: The new tool allows for testing alternative deployment configurations, enabling developers to measure latency, throughput, and cost metrics before promoting changes to production.
top_news.image_alt: Modal dashboard showing endpoint candidate evaluation

top_news.title: Queues - Queues now supports EU, US, and FedRAMP jurisdictions
top_news.dek: Cloudflare Queues now supports jurisdictional restrictions for EU, US, and FedRAMP, ensuring data residency compliance.
top_news.brief: Developers can now restrict message storage and processing to specific regions using the --jurisdiction flag in the Cloudflare CLI, facilitating compliance with GDPR and FedRAMP requirements.
top_news.image_alt: Cloudflare CLI command for jurisdiction-restricted queues

primary.title: Queues - Queues now supports EU, US, and FedRAMP jurisdictions
primary.summary: You can now create Cloudflare Queues with jurisdictional restrictions, ensuring that messages published to a queue are stored and processed only within a specific jurisdiction. This helps you comply with data residency requirements such as the GDPR ↗︎ or FedRAMP ↗︎. To create a jurisdiction-restricted queue with the Cloudflare CLI (cf), use the --jurisdiction flag: cf queues create --queue-name my-eu-queue --jurisdiction eu You can also pass a jurisdiction parameter when calling the Create Queue endpoint: curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$ACCOUNT_ID/queues \ --request POST \
